mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS record_id, r.observation_session_id, r.student_id, r.creator_id, r.record_time, r.antecedent_code, ant.label AS antecedent_label, r.behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, r.consequence_code, ct.label AS consequence_label, r.assistance_result, r.assistance_other_description, r.frequency, r.duration_seconds, r.remark, os.id AS session_id, os.student_id AS session_student_id, os.creator_id AS session_creator_id, os.observation_date AS session_observation_date, os.course_code AS session_course_code, course.label AS session_course_label, os.course_other_description AS session_course_other_description, os.environment_code AS session_environment_code, env.label AS session_environment_label, os.environment_other_description AS session_environment_other_description, os.observation_duration_minutes AS session_duration_minutes, os.period_behavior_remark AS session_period_behavior_remark, at.code AS assistance_code, at.label AS assistance_label FROM behavior_record r JOIN observation_session os ON os.id = r.observation_session_id JOIN course_type course ON course.code = os.course_code JOIN environment_type env ON env.code = os.environment_code LEFT JOIN antecedent_type ant ON ant.code = r.antecedent_code JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = r.behavior_code LEFT JOIN consequence_type ct ON ct.code = r.consequence_code LEFT JOIN behavior_record_assistance bra ON bra.behavior_record_id = r.id LEFT JOIN assistance_type at ON at.code = bra.assistance_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_record (observation_session_id, student_id, creator_id, record_time, antecedent_code, behavior_code, consequence_code, assistance_result, assistance_other_description, frequency, duration_seconds, remark) VALUES (#{observationSessionId}, #{studentId}, #{creatorId}, #{recordTime}, #{antecedentCode}, #{behaviorCode}, #{consequenceCode}, #{assistanceResult}, #{assistanceOtherDescription}, #{frequency}, #{durationSeconds}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_record SET record_time = #{recordTime}, antecedent_code = #{antecedentCode}, behavior_code = #{behaviorCode}, consequence_code = #{consequenceCode}, assistance_result = #{assistanceResult}, assistance_other_description = #{assistanceOtherDescription}, frequency = #{frequency}, duration_seconds = #{durationSeconds}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
